hook: Gina Papush is listed by Reuters Events as SVP and Chief Data Officer, Fannie Mae, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Gina Papush's LinkedIn profile, the post began in April 2025, after chief analytics and chief data roles at Bristol Myers Squibb and QBE Insurance and operations leadership at Cigna.

editor_points.desc: According to Gina Papush's LinkedIn profile: SVP and chief data officer at Fannie Mae since April 2025; chief analytics officer at Bristol Myers Squibb from 2022 to 2024; enterprise operations leadership at Cigna from 2018 to 2022; global chief data and analytics officer at QBE Insurance from 2016 to 2018; non-executive board member of IAT Insurance Group; adjunct faculty at Carnegie Mellon. MS in statistics, UMBC; applied mathematics, Karazin Kharkiv National University. The profile is Gina Papush's own account and has not been checked against other records.
